subject.title: Bound plugin bundle command file reads with size cap

question: Should plugin bundle commands above the chosen safety limit be rejected with an explicit recoverable diagnostic, and what compatibility promise should OpenClaw make for existing oversized command files?
rationale: A fixed limit mitigates unbounded allocation but intentionally changes the behavior of already-installed command content; the correct limit and user recovery contract require product ownership.

options.title: Adopt a documented bounded-command contract
options.body: Keep a justified limit, emit an actionable diagnostic naming the skipped command, and add regression coverage for oversized rejection plus continued sibling loading.

options.title: Defer this cap
options.body: Leave existing command loading unchanged until the plugin command size contract and recovery surface are designed.

recommendation.title: Adopt a documented bounded-command contract
recommendation.body: Keep a justified limit, emit an actionable diagnostic naming the skipped command, and add regression coverage for oversized rejection plus continued sibling loading.
